Get LBA Roster Coach

Source: R/lba.R
lba_roster_coach.Rd

Head coach of one team-season.

Endpoint: GET https://www.legabasket.it/api/teams/get-team-roster (id=<team_id>)

Usage

lba_roster_coach(team_id)

Arguments

team_id

(required) Team id (team_id in lba_teams), e.g. 1764. One team-season: ids are re-issued every season.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Head coach of one team-season. The columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py lba_roster_coach); a column the site adds later is appended after them:

col_nametypedescription
team_idintegerTeam-season id (re-issued every season); join lba_teams for the stable club_id.
club_idintegerClub id: the cross-season join key for team ids (only here and in the team headers); stability across seasons is unverified.
club_codecharacterClub code (TVB, TS); whether it is stable across seasons is unverified.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27): the row's START year + 1.
coach_idintegerCoach id (global coach key space; joins the game header home_coach_id / visitor_coach_id).
namecharacterCoach's given name.
surnamecharacterCoach's family name.
birth_datecharacterBirth date, Date YYYY-MM-DD.
place_of_birthcharacterBirthplace (Italian spelling, e.g. Londra).
coach_type_idintegerCoach role id (1 = head coach).
coach_type_descriptioncharacterCoach role, Italian: Allenatore = head coach.
coach_type_codecharacterCoach role code, number sent as a string.
team_namecharacterTeam, short name.
coach_picture_keycharacterImage key: the image is {cdn_url}/{key}, resized copies {cdn_url}/variants/{key}/thumb or /large (the site's getApiImageUrl).
team_logo_keycharacterImage key: the image is {cdn_url}/{key}, resized copies {cdn_url}/variants/{key}/thumb or /large (the site's getApiImageUrl).

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the JSON API that the Next.js site www.legabasket.it itself calls. Legal notice: the site's terms say "Non e' consentito copiare ... dati e informazioni senza autorizzazione scritta" (copying data and information without written authorisation is not allowed), except for personal, non-commercial use. The owner accepted the restriction for this intake on 2026-10-12. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets, and any published data release of this source needs separate sign-off.

  • robots.txt allows /api and sets Crawl-delay: 2. The runtime waits 2 s before every request, retries included. Crawl incrementally: fetch a final game once (keyed by game_id), find new games with one lba_calendar call per round, and do not backfill a history in a burst.

  • Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026-27); the site sends START years and the runtime maps them (season - 1 on the wire). Game and player ids are global; team ids are re-issued every season (join lba_teams for the stable club_id); a championship id is one season AND one phase (Regular Season and Play Off differ).

  • Play-by-play starts in 2017-18 and changes shape in 2019-20 (pixel frame to court percent) and 2021-22; see lba_pbp. Box scores reach back to 1995-96, where the period scores were not recorded (0 means missing).

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, or a body with no rows: an unknown season, a play-by-play before 2017-18, standings of a finished championship without a round), hoopR_bad_request (a season that is not an END year, a bad choice, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, an empty / non-JSON / error-shaped 200, a game that is not final on the box score, play-by-play and shot routes, a truncated page, or a body for another season, championship, game, team, player, round or category than the one asked for). An unknown id is HTTP 500, which is not retried. A body the parser finds no rows in gives a zero-row tibble with these columns.

See also

Other LBA Functions: lba_box_score(), lba_calendar(), lba_championships(), lba_game(), lba_game_log(), lba_pbp(), lba_pbp_legend(), lba_player(), lba_player_stats(), lba_players(), lba_players_leaderboard(), lba_roster(), lba_shots(), lba_standings(), lba_team_box_score(), lba_team_players_stats(), lba_teams(), lba_teams_leaderboard()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(lba_roster_coach(team_id = 1764))
#> ── LBA Roster Coach from legabasket.it ───────────────────── hoopR 3.1.0.9000 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-18 15:43:14 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 15
#>   team_id club_id club_code season coach_id name    surname birth_date
#>     <int>   <int> <chr>      <int>    <int> <chr>   <chr>   <chr>     
#> 1    1764     107 TVU         2027      339 Marcelo Nicola  1971-05-12
#> # ℹ 7 more variables: place_of_birth <chr>, coach_type_id <int>,
#> #   coach_type_description <chr>, coach_type_code <chr>, team_name <chr>,
#> #   coach_picture_key <chr>, team_logo_key <chr>
# }
